title: File:Caprimulgus rufigena, roep van grondpad, 1 min 6 s, Bellary-gasteplaas, Vredefort, b.mp3
author: JMK
description: Rufous-cheeked nightjar ( Caprimulgus rufigena rufigena ) calling after sunset, 18:48, from a dirt road in open grassland near Bellary guest farm west of Vredefort, northern Free State, South Africa. The monotonous churring is preceded and interspersed by some "chewook" notes. Helmeted guineafowl are audible in the background.
